clue.text: A down-to earth serving man

parts.note: reads as a modest, unpretentious servant, but means a soldier who serves by dropping down to the ground from the sky

explanation.surface: A praise of some humble, practical attendant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down-to earth' looks like the idiom for sensible; literally it is a soldier coming down to earth by parachute.
explanation.definitionFit: An airborne infantryman is a serviceman who descends to the ground under a canopy.

clue.text: They've got round by sea

parts.note: suggests sailors who have travelled around by ship, but describes small stones made smooth and rounded by the waves on a beach

explanation.surface: Sailors who have managed to get around by sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Got round' suggests travelling; it means having been rounded by the action of the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Beach stones are worn smooth and rounded by the tide's constant tumbling.

clue.text: True blue!

definitions.meaning: conservative in politics; blue is the British Conservative Party's colour, so politically to that side

explanation.definitionFit: Correct is a synonym of the first sense, while the Tory colour stands for the conservative political wing.

clue.text: He needles his clients constantly

parts.note: reads as someone who keeps irritating customers, but describes a worker who literally uses needles on customers all day

explanation.surface: A tradesman who keeps annoying his customers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needles' sounds like teasing or provoking; literally it is inking skin with a needle.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin artist works with needles, injecting ink into customers' skin.

clue.text: Solo rendered in capital fashion

indicators.note: rendered here means made into something new, so the four letters of the clue word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A solo performed in grand style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rendered' signals the anagram of SOLO; 'capital fashion' reads as a performance done splendidly but 'capital' is the definition, a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's seat of government is the city named here.

clue.text: Worth a great deal, though somewhat over-refined

definitions.meaning: affectedly fussy or dainty in manner or style

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both valuable and affectedly dainty, as in a mannered literary style.

clue.text: Sack the fellow in anger

indicators.note: the fellow is placed inside the word for anger

parts.note: to anger someone is to rile them

explanation.surface: Fire the man, in a fit of rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sack' looks like dismissing someone; it means to ransack or plunder. 'In' puts F inside RILE.
explanation.definitionFit: To ransack a place is to plunder it, as when a drawer is searched through roughly.

clue.text: Most profound nuisance at the bottom of a river

indicators.note: in a down entry, the word for nuisance sits below the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain, a common crossword river
a pest is an annoying nuisance

explanation.surface: Something annoying lurking at the bed of a river.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'at the bottom of' puts PEST below DEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Deepest is the superlative of profound in its sense of reaching far down.

clue.text: This will blow up, creating general confusion, right?

indicators.note: confusion here means the letters of the word general are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A bomb that will explode, spreading chaos everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow up' suggests explosion; it means enlarging a photograph. 'Confusion' makes ENLARGE from GENERAL, then R is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographic darkroom device projects a negative to make a bigger print, so it magnifies pictures.

clue.text: Woman carrying a gun to get game

indicators.note: the woman's word holds the other pieces inside it, as if carrying them

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: A woman with a firearm out to shoot something for the pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' looks like quarry for shooting; it is a table game played with balls and pins. 'Carrying' puts A GAT inside BELLE; GAT is old US slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: A table pastime in which balls are struck into holes guarded by pins.

clue.text: Some delinquents require such a guard

definitions.text: Some delinquents require such a guard

parts.words: Some delinquents require such a guard
parts.note: reads as a barrier to keep young offenders in, but also points to the criminal's receiver of stolen goods, as well as a protective barrier

explanation.surface: Young offenders needing a security barrier around them.
explanation.walkthrough: The word means both a barrier and someone who buys and sells stolen goods, which thieves need.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in stolen property is needed by thieves, and a garden barrier serves as a guard.

clue.text: See to turning it on for the wash

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: turning means the little word it is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Looking after laundry by switching on the machine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning' reverses IT to TI; 'for the wash' looks like laundry but a wash here is a liquid applied to the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A liquid preparation applied to the skin, such as a soothing skin wash.

clue.text: Being well-informed, the Left recapitulate

parts.note: to iterate is to repeat or restate, as in recapitulating

explanation.surface: A political left showing how knowledgeable it is by going over things again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recapitulate' is not an anagram signal here: it supplies ITERATE, a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Literate can mean educated and knowledgeable in a field, not merely able to read.

clue.text: A flier in his cups is kingly

indicators.note: the bird is found inside a run of letters in the words that follow

explanation.surface: A man who becomes regal when drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In his cups' is an idiom for drunk; but 'in' signals the bird hidden in cupS IS KINgly.
explanation.definitionFit: A small finch is a bird, and birds are fliers.

clue.text: Give voice about reversing vehicle, which can be irritating

indicators.note: the word for give voice goes around the other piece

parts.note: to sing is to give voice

indicators.note: reversing means the vehicle's name is read backwards

parts.note: a tram is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Shouting about a car backing up, which is annoying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reversing' turns TRAM into MART, which 'about' puts inside SING.
explanation.definitionFit: Smarting describes a stinging pain, as from a sore, irritated wound.

clue.text: Totally striking 2

parts.note: workers on strike are said to be out
the answer to 2 down

explanation.surface: Completely remarkable, says the cross-reference.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' refers to the answer of 2 down, RIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Outright means completely or wholly, as in won outright.

clue.text: Some soldiers offer to take the place of others

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to present something is to offer it

explanation.surface: Troops volunteering to stand in for others.
explanation.walkthrough: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: To act for or speak on behalf of someone is to stand in for them.

clue.text: Underwear delay-that's to follow

indicators.note: the abbreviation for that is comes after the word for delay

parts.note: to linger is to delay or dawdle
i.e. is short for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Lingering over undergarments, with more to come.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's underclothes are known by this French-derived word.

clue.text: Set out a popular fruit

parts.note: to plant is to set out seedlings in the ground
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Arranging a well-loved piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set out' looks like an anagram signal; it means to plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy banana-like fruit eaten cooked in the tropics.

clue.text: Advocate quiet guide

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
a leader guides others

explanation.surface: A lawyer acting as a soft-spoken mentor.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who argues a case in court is a pleading lawyer.

clue.text: Enthusiasm for the hard stuff

definitions.meaning: zest, liveliness, as in team morale
strong distilled alcohol such as whisky

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both liveliness of mind and strong distilled liquor.

clue.text: Trade is bad, resulting in much abuse

indicators.note: bad here means the letters of the two words are spoilt and rearranged

explanation.surface: Poor business leading to a lot of complaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bad' rearranges TRADE IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Long angry speeches of denunciation pour out a lot of verbal attack.

clue.text: Reagents used to cause a separation

indicators.note: used here suggests the letters of the chemical word are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: Chemicals employed to split a substance apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Used' rearranges REAGENTS; the chemistry setting hides the sense of alienating people.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate people from one another is to drive them apart.

clue.text: A bluff upstanding moralist

indicators.note: in a down entry, upstanding means the word for bluff is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a pose is a bluff or pretence

explanation.surface: An honest teacher of morals who is also a bit of a deceiver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upstanding' looks like honest; in a down clue it reverses POSE to ESOP.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek fabulist's tales each end with a lesson, so he is a teller of morals.

clue.text: Old copper may be seen in the kitchen

definitions.meaning: an old slang word for a policeman, from Sir Robert Peel who founded the London police

definitions.text: may be seen in the kitchen
definitions.meaning: a gadget for stripping skin from vegetables

explanation.definitionFit: Early London police officers were nicknamed after Peel, and the same word names a potato-skinning utensil.

clue.text: Catch a girl out initially

parts.note: a lass is a girl

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of the word out

explanation.surface: Grabbing a girl who has stepped outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy's rope with a noose is used to snare cattle.

clue.text: Sword borne by the peers of the realm

indicators.note: the weapon is carried within the run of letters of these words

explanation.surface: A ceremonial blade carried by the nobility.
explanation.walkthrough: The sword sits inside thE PEErs.
explanation.definitionFit: A fencing blade with a stiff triangular cross-section.

clue.text: Gets some food and departs about noon

indicators.note: the word for departs goes around the letter for noon

parts.note: to die is to depart this life

explanation.surface: Someone eats a bit and leaves around midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Departs' means DIES, as in departing this life.
explanation.definitionFit: To dine is to eat a meal.

clue.text: Newsmen, gaining admission to animal retreat, checked

indicators.note: the journalists go inside the reversed animal
retreat means the animal's name goes backwards

parts.note: a deer is an animal
the press means journalists collectively

explanation.surface: Reporters get into an animal sanctuary and are stopped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retreat' looks like a refuge; it reverses DEER to REED, which PRESS enters.
explanation.definitionFit: Repressed means held back or restrained, as feelings are kept in check.

clue.text: Putting on airs about temporary accommodation in good environs

indicators.note: environs means the word for good surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: pious means devout, morally good
re means about, concerning
a tent is temporary shelter

explanation.surface: A snob complaining about camping in a respectable neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Environs' puts RE TENT inside PIOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing off affectedly, trying to seem grander than one is.
